tier.howIntro: Each spec gets a score from 0 to 100 on the current season's ladder, from three factors:
tier.densityText: How many of the top 250, 500, 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000 players play the spec, weighted 30, 25, 20, 15 and 10%. Each band is measured against the spec that leads it.
tier.representationText: How many players at or above {floor} play the spec. Specs are ranked by that count: the most played gets all the points, the least none, the rest in between.
tier.averageText: The spec's average at or above {floor}, ranked the same way. It is taken as if every spec had 50 more players at {floor}, so a spec with few players counts for less.
tier.boundariesText: Specs are ordered by score and cut at 10, 35, 65 and 90% of the list. Each line moves up to two specs to fall on the widest gap between scores, so specs that score close together share a tier.
tier.note: Recomputed every hour from the live ladder. Every spec is listed, even one nobody plays.
